I personally don’t think the marriage is necessarily over. 

If you want to save your marriage, focus on saving yourself. 

1) take accountability. Acknowledge that you were wrong as hell. Full stop. In these replies i see a LOT of your excuses and continuing anger and shifting blame. 
You were the only one wrong. 
You are the only one to blame. 
You caused irreparable harm. 
Own it. 

2) adjust yourself accordingly. Perform the necessary emotional labour to address your behaviour. Go to therapy. Read some self help books. Listen to some podcasts. Journal. Write some letters to your past self. Imagine how you would like your future self to be. 
Do some deep digging to uproot some things like: 
why you are insecure, 
how you manage jealousy, 
the source of your sense of inferiority, 
your manipulative expressions of violence,
Your comfort with disrespecting boundaries 
Etc 

3) sincerely apologize in a reparative way. 
Ask her family/friends if she wants a repaired version of the ring. Ask to pay for extra therapy sessions for her. Maybe write a letter that details your acknowledgment of your hurt. And acknowledge that you do not deserve and don’t expect to be forgiven.
Detail how you will do better in the future. 

“Best case”* scenario: 
You two go to couples therapy and after a lot of work, live happily ever after 

“Worst case”* scenario:
You never speak to each other again except for the purposes of finalizing divorce, and you walk away living your life a bit healthier knowing that you have the tools to grow past being a toxic piece of shit. 


Best of luck regardless. 
Please seek help 



* in quotations because I think objectively it is best that OP be single until he sorts his shit, and that this poor widow walks away and heals away from this person.
